verdict.rationale: Nothing in the pack documents replaying archived events or backfilling history into a newly added or repaired destination. The closest item, Warehouse Sync, ingests data from the customer's own warehouse into mParticle. That is a different capability from replaying mParticle's event archive to downstream tools, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I can replay archived events into a new destination or backfill history when a tool is added or a pipeline breaks
